content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 denies the claim for missing required prior authorization; the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available because a denial is on the table, and supporting clinical documentation can be used without inventing a claim-data correction. Appeal is the next appropriate step rather than transferring an authorization denial to the patient or escalating while an available action can progress the claim.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
